entities.name: EPSP synthase P9WJM1
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (418 aa) to reviewed Mycobacterium tuberculosis UDP-N-acetylglucosamine 1-carboxyvinyltransferase; EC 2.5.1.7.
Catalyzes transfer of an enolpyruvyl group from phosphoenolpyruvate to UDP-N-acetylglucosamine in peptidoglycan biosynthesis.
Annotated as cytoplasmic; Pfam EPSP_synthase domain spans residues 7–406.
Predicted unmodified protein properties: 44,063 Da; pI 5.30; instability index 28.49; GRAVY 0.192.

entities.name: UDP-GlcNAc enolpyruvylation
observations: PEP + UDP-N-acetylglucosamine → UDP-N-acetyl-3-O-(1-carboxyvinyl)-glucosamine + phosphate; EC 2.5.1.7; Rhea RHEA:18681.

entities.name: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis
observations: The protein is annotated in cell-wall biogenesis and peptidoglycan biosynthesis.
Related GO annotations include GO:0009252 and cytoplasmic localization GO:0005737.
